presentation.label: HYDRA
presentation.summary: Two extra playheads on one delay: a double-time ghost an octave up and a half-time drag an octave down, locked to tempo. Built for drums.
presentation.overview: Two extra playheads on one delay: a double-time ghost an octave up and a half-time drag an octave down, locked to tempo. Built for drums.

controls.name: Div
controls.doc: Re-trigger length as a division of Tempo. Position 0 is Grain: a fixed 256-sample window, free-running, which is the granular octave-shifter mode the tempo ladder cannot reach. Above that: 1/32, 1/16T, 1/16, 1/8T, 1/8, dotted 1/8, 1/4. Default 42 = 1/16 (DSP range 32-43); 1/8T starts at 44. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Tempo
controls.doc: BPM, read straight off the knob. Clamped to 40..240 in the DSP. Ignored when Div is at Grain. Range 0–240.

controls.name: Fast
controls.doc: Level of the 2x head: double-time ghost, octave up. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Slow
controls.doc: Level of the 0.5x head: half-time drag, octave down. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Tone
controls.doc: Low-pass on the two layers only; the dry stays open. Range 0–100.

limitations: Hardware untested on the original MS-70CDR with OS 2.10.
This build has startup knob initialization disabled. Check saved settings after recalling a patch.
